client views on FOCIL for Glamsterdam

summary_en: DamianStraszak summarized why shielded pools have been slow to catch on in the EVM and proposed fixes. soispoke reported the last ACD: the community wants FOCIL in Glamsterdam, and 3 of 5 consensus clients back SFI. pcaversaccio noted that with PeerDAS cell KZG proofs, presigned old style EIP-4844 txs stop propagating after Osaka.
